name: The Citizens Foundation USA
mission:
The Citizens Foundation, USA (TCF-USA) is a professionally managed tax-exempt charity, with a support network of volunteer chapters across the USA. We support the building of civil society in Pakistan by providing quality education to underprivileged children, promoting gender equality & partnering for reform of public education. We believe that education is a basic human right. Universal access to education is a prerequisite for democratic institutions to flourish in Pakistan and for its people to compete in a global economy.
TCF currently has 1,833 schools in all the provinces of Pakistan with 280,000 children enrolled, nearly half of them girls. TCF has trained and employed 13,000 women as teachers and principals, making it the largest employer of women in the private sector.
TCF also provides scholarships for tertiary education to the deserving graduates of its' secondary schools and an adult literacy program that has transformed the lives of women.
theoryOfChange: The Citizens Foundation USA (TCF-USA) outlines its strategy for mitigating the education crisis post-COVID-19, built around three primary objectives: Retaining TCF students, Expanding Access, and Re-enrolling private school dropouts. This document details how TCF-USA aims to achieve its mission through these strategic objectives.

strengths_deep_dive: The Citizens Foundation USA demonstrates strong financial discipline by allocating <cite id="1">88.4% of its expenses directly to educational programs in FY2024</cite>. This exceeds the standard 75% benchmark. Charity Navigator awards the organization an <cite id="1">overall score of 99.3/100</cite>, citing perfect scores in culture and leadership alongside an <cite id="1">accountability score of 98.0/100</cite>. Furthermore, TCF USA maintains high operational transparency through its Candid Platinum Seal and publishes clear outcome statistics.
rich_narrative.summary: The Citizens Foundation USA supports civil society in Pakistan by building and operating purpose-built schools for underprivileged children <cite id="1">founded in 1995</cite>. In FY2024, the charity managed <cite id="3">$21,703,144 in total revenue</cite> to expand its educational network. The organization maintains strong financial efficiency, directing <cite id="1">88.4% of expenses to program activities</cite> with low fundraising costs of <cite id="1">$0.10 per $1 raised</cite>. The charity is <cite id="2">zakat-eligible</cite>, targeting support to poor and needy families (fuqara and masakin). TCF USA operates at scale, educating hundreds of thousands of students across thousands of operational school units in Pakistan while keeping cost per beneficiary exceptionally low.
